sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 20% of max HP every 5 seconds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Prohibits Unison for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Applies Cypher Pain to the enemy field for 120 seconds. (Boosts time Unison damage taken by 30%. Reduces ATK/MATK by 30%.)
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
